info.syllabusName: Ngôn ngữ học, xã hội và văn hóa (Language, Society and Culture)
info.description: This course includes nine chapters. It provides students with basic concepts and central issues in the field of sociolinguistics. Also, it demonstrates the interrelationship of language and society.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand social impacts on language; have in-depth knowledge about social and cultural diversity in exposing to various cultural customs.
Use the knowledge provided in the course to discuss theories relating to linguistics and society.
Recognise research objectives in line with the notions; analyse and recognise social impacts on language.

Have appropriate attitudes and behavior toward the knowledge, and apply the knowledge to meet expectations of specific tasks; have work ethics relating to the course; recognise the importance of the course, the meanings relating to society and humanity.
